verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers GitHub-integrated automation (@gemini-cli mentions for task delegation, PR review, issue triage) and non-interactive/scriptable execution plus Cloud Shell availability, which together approximate a 'cloud agent' workflow for building and reviewing changes. However there is no dedicated build+test+demo pipeline, and community reports describe agentic failures (loops, stuck edits, botched file operations) that undercut reliability for autonomous end-to-end delivery. Missing for 10: explicit testing/demo generation step, evidence of reliable autonomous multi-stage execution, and first-party documentation of a full build-test-demo cloud agent flow.
